requirement: Account model subscriptions share routing across surfaces and fall back to Tracy AI only with account consent before output

oracle.invariant: S1: anonymous reads are refused; both accounts can read only safe metadata; changing A does not change B; cross-origin and stale updates are refused; the saved preference is restored. S2: fallback defaults on, disabled consent prevents fallback, account and site fences hold, failures retry at most once, partial output and cancellation cannot replay, and the normal Tracy runtime receives the default model and correct identity.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

partial output is never replayed onto a different subscription
